text:
Riya: Quick alert: hit a p99 regression on r7-gpu when compact and cross-node steals overlapped. Repro in perf harness attached.

Ben: Paste the minimal trace please.

Riya: sequence: many tiny 2-6KB tensors -> local slab fragmented -> compaction starts and holds slab lock -> allocator falls back to remote steals -> eviction promotes pages that compactor expects -> compaction retries and stalls -> tail spike.

Cole: Sounds like a locking/coordination gap. Two short-term mitigations: (1) make compaction incremental/cooperative (cursor + step) so it yields frequently, or (2) make eviction respect compaction in-flight by deprioritizing pages touched by the cursor.

Maya: Both are doable. Cooperative compaction buys latency immediately; eviction-awareness reduces noisy retries. We should probably do both but ship cooperative compaction first.

Ben: Cooperative API sketch: compact_start(slab_id) -> returns cursor; compact_step(cursor, work_budget_bytes) -> returns (cursor, progress_bytes, yielded_bool); compact_finish(cursor). Keep cursor opaque ~8 bytes.

Riya: I like an 8-byte cursor (slab_idx:u32, subpage:u16, offset:u16). Minimal per-tenant memory and idempotent.

Cole: Eviction hint: add a transient field in residency metadata 'compaction_epoch' with TTL. Evict scoring subtracts priority for pages with a recent epoch. If evict retries > threshold, fallback to conservative demote.

Maya: Telemetry: add compact_yields, cursor_staleness_ms, eviction_retries_per_min. Alert if eviction_retries_per_min > 10.

Ben: Implementation notes: compact_step should be non-blocking and scheduled on compactor pool. Use work_budget as bytes moved or ms to keep deterministic. If yielded, re-enqueue later.

Riya: Rollout: canary on r7-gpu with flags {"compact_coop":true, "evict_hint_ttl":120}. infra-bot create canary.

infra-bot: Canary created -> id=canary-1745000012 target=r7-gpu config={"compact_coop":true,"evict_hint_ttl":120} 

Cole: Perf plan: microbatch generator with forced offload GC. Measure p50/p95/p99, compact_yields, CPU delta. Compare current vs cooperative vs cooperative+evict-hint.

Maya: Owners: Ben -> compact cursor PR; Riya -> evict scoring + hint; Cole -> perf runs + harness tweaks; I'll add telemetry and dashboards.

Ben: I'll do a small PR for compact_step skeleton this week. Keep cursor opaque and version it in case we extend.

Riya: Also add a cheap fallback: if compaction detects heavy contention it should abort and mark slab for passive compaction later to avoid holding locks.

Cole: Good call. Also make sure eviction doesn't starve compaction forever; balance with a small backoff window.

Maya: We'll gate by feature flags and run canary for 24h soak. If p99 improves with <15% CPU hit, expand.

Riya: Thanks everyone. I'll post perf logs and heap sketch link once canary is live.

Ben: :+1:
